# Better GitHub Explore

> A replacement UI for github.com/explore: GitHub's trending repositories, topics, collections, events and sponsorable projects, in one place.

Everything below is a snapshot taken from github.com at 2026-08-29T03:19:25.071Z and served statically from https://modularmechanic.github.io/better-github-explore/. Star counts and rankings are accurate as of that moment, not as of when you are reading this.

The site itself renders client-side, so fetching https://modularmechanic.github.io/better-github-explore/ returns an empty page shell. This file is the machine-readable version of what it lists.

## Topics

- [Awesome Lists](https://github.com/topics/awesome): An awesome list is a list of awesome things curated by the community.
- [Chrome](https://github.com/topics/chrome): Chrome is a web browser from the tech company Google.
- [Code quality](https://github.com/topics/code-quality): Automate your code review with style, quality, security, and test‑coverage checks when you need them.
- [Compiler](https://github.com/topics/compiler): Compilers are software that translate higher-level programming languages to lower-level languages (e.g. machine code).
- [CSS](https://github.com/topics/css): Cascading Style Sheets (CSS) is a language used most often to style and improve upon the appearance of views.
- [Database](https://github.com/topics/database): A database is a structured set of data held in a computer, usually a server.
- [Front end](https://github.com/topics/frontend): Front end is the programming and layout that people see and interact with.
- [JavaScript](https://github.com/topics/javascript): JavaScript (JS) is a lightweight interpreted programming language with first-class functions.
- [Node.js](https://github.com/topics/nodejs): Node.js is a tool for executing JavaScript in a variety of environments.
- [npm](https://github.com/topics/npm): npm is a package manager for JavaScript included with Node.js.
- [Project management](https://github.com/topics/project-management): Project management is about building scope and executing on the project's goals.
- [Python](https://github.com/topics/python): Python is a dynamically typed programming language.
- [React](https://github.com/topics/react): React is an open source JavaScript library used for designing user interfaces.
- [React Native](https://github.com/topics/react-native): React Native is a JavaScript mobile framework developed by Facebook.
- [Scala](https://github.com/topics/scala): Scala is an object-oriented programming language.
- [TypeScript](https://github.com/topics/typescript): TypeScript is a typed superset of JavaScript that compiles to plain JavaScript.
